svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Showcase gallery: Fleet line stack, 2 000 lanes in 3D
svg.desc: The showcase gallery on a 3D page. The left nav lists 2D time-series vis, 3D signal views, 3D scenes and axis patterns, each tagged 2D or 3D; Fleet line stack is selected. The centre renders it live: 2 000 synthetic node CPU lanes as a 3D line stack with X time over seven days, Y value and Z one lane per member. The front 48 lanes are drawn as lines with curtains, the rest collapse into min–max bands that fade into depth fog, and three outlier lanes cross the 85% threshold and are lit Degraded; one is hovered with a tooltip. A readout shows 60 fps, 6.8 ms frame time, 4.03 M points and 2 000 lanes; a renderer tier switch offers WebGPU or WebGL2; projection chips offer Perspective or Ortho and camera presets Front, Top, Side and Reset. A frame-time strip and key hints sit below. On the right an editable declarative spec in monospace, with one edited line, re-renders live, and a Use in a board button copies the spec and camera into a board.
